comments.body:
Hi @pcbeingused333 

Thanks for this. Looks good.

One thing that would be good to have in the PR description is:

Because the read no longer waits for the environment update, enabling the port 80 listener (`http_listener_enabled = true`) and `loadbalancer_redirect_http_to_https` in the same apply on an existing environment now fails at plan with "listener not found". Before this change it worked, because the read ran after the update. To get around it, requires applying twice.

I also noticed that the doc link is out of date - could you please update it to point to the latest version of the docs?

@joe-niland Thanks, I added an upgrade note to the description about enabling the port 80 listener and the redirect in the same apply (apply twice), and updated the docs link to the current page.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

<!-- release-pr-comment:457521935 -->
  These changes were released in [v1.0.1](https://github.com/cloudposse/terraform-aws-elastic-beanstalk-environment/releases/tag/v1.0.1).
